newsitem.title: UK: Emerging markets boutique Caspian raises $85 mln.
newsitem.headline: Emerging markets boutique Caspian raises $85 mln.

text.p: Emerging markets investment bank Caspian Securities, which was set up by former Barings Asian star Christopher Heath, has raised $85 million via a rights offering to existing shareholders to expand the company's capital base to $100 million.
"We now have a wide spread of investors with no single institution having a major shareholding," Heath said in a statement.

He said that the new money, which included cash from investors in Korea, Thailand, Singapore, India and Mexico, would enable Caspian to expand on its initial broking business into corporate finance and asset management.
"We are having advanced discussions with a number of new investors, who initially approached us," Heath said.

The company began trading in 1995 and will open offices in Kuala Lumpur and Bangkok and is considering opening in Taipei, Manila and Jakarta in addition to its existing branches in Asia and Latin America.
"We are developing Caspian as originally planned, starting in Latin America and expanding as an independent investment group, particularly in South East Asia and emerging Europe," Heath said.
